biggest_catch: Your friend must be brand-new to iQ (18+, U.S. lawful permanent resident, natural person), open savings + checking + Easy Savings accounts with an activated debit card, e-Statements, and a $5 minimum savings balance, all within 60 days; your $100 posts on the 61st day after account opening and both accounts must be open and in good standing then.
catches: Friend must be 18+, a natural person, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., and new to iQ; business, trust, estate, club, custodial, youth, and similar accounts are not eligible.
Friend must open a savings account, checking account, and Easy Savings account, obtain and maintain an activated debit card, and enroll in e-Statements; $5 minimum balance in savings.
All requirements must be met within 60 days of membership opening; accounts must be open and in good standing (not overdrawn 30+ days, no legal orders, no iQ loan 30+ days past due).
Reward deposited 61 days after account opening; iQ cannot tell you whether your friend named you or opened an account.
New member can earn only one $100 referral reward; existing members have no limit on the number of referral rewards.
Employees, board members, and their immediate family are ineligible; joint owners of existing accounts opening their own new account are ineligible.
Cannot be combined with any other offer; reward value may be reported to the IRS and is the recipient's tax responsibility; terms can change and the promotion can end without notice.

steps: Tell your friend to mention your name (or use your referral link/form) when opening a new iQ Credit Union membership.
Friend opens savings, checking, and Easy Savings accounts, activates their debit card, enrolls in e-Statements, and keeps at least $5 in savings, all within 60 days.
Accounts remain open and in good standing through day 61 after account opening.
$100 is credited to your iQ account for the qualifying referral.
timing: Reward credited to the referrer's iQ account 61 days after the friend's account opening, once all requirements are met and both accounts are open and in good standing.
